51464619.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant LIMK1 (330 to 637 residues) (unknown origin) expressed in baculovirus infected insect cells assessed as dissociation constant at 10 uM by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.ITC Measurements: Measurements were performed at 20 °C on a MicroCal VP-ITC (GE Healthcare). LIMK1330–637 was dialyzed overnight into assay buffer (20 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM TCEP, 5% glycerol). The syringe was loaded with 105 μM LIMK1330–637, and the cell was filled with assay buffer containing 10 μM of the respective inhibitor. Every 5 minutes, 10 μL of the protein solution was injected into the cell for a total of 28 injections. The heat flow data were analyzed with the MicroCal ORIGIN software package employing a single binding site model.

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM TCEP, 5% glycerol
